acceptance.criterion: Pixel 7 desk: every desk object visible above the card; screenPos('desk') y above the card's top
acceptance.command: CAPTURE_STOPS=desk CAPTURE_DIALOGS=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/capture.spec.ts --grep @capture --project=pixel7, plus a scratch probe of screenPos('desk') and the desk card rect
acceptance.evidence: Before (34a5555): card top 346 px of 839, the desk projected below it (only the beam and end-wall line visible); screenPos('desk') returned null (the desk has no exhibit hit box). After: card top 377 px (closing line dropped on museum-mode portrait phones), desk framing point 34% of the height on the desk stop only; screenPos('desk') = (201, 339), 38 px above the card top. The capture shows the walnut desk with postcard, envelope, catalogue and ledger above the card, the end-wall line just under the HUD buttons, and the year chip reading FRONT DESK. Desktop desk framing is unchanged (deskWeightAt applies to portrait only). Rebaseline of stop-desk-pixel7 deferred to R0 in CI.

acceptance.criterion: Desktop story dialog: no HUD, rail or wing text inside the panel; e2e assertion
acceptance.evidence: New dialog.spec (n) at safe-sip (volunteer wing): hud-progress, exit-wing, hud-pdf, hud-classic and the stop card are hidden while the story is open, a text-node scan finds no page text under the panel, and all return after Esc with focus on Read the story. Negative check: with the two hide rules disabled the test fails (hud-progress toBeHidden, received visible). After captures verafin-dialog-desktop and safe-sip-dialog-desktop show a clean panel. dialog.spec: 28 passed, 10 skipped (project filters) on desktop and pixel7.

acceptance.criterion: Desktop dialog: the case is fully visible, uncovered by the card and left of the panel (verafin, safe-sip)
acceptance.command: CAPTURE_STOPS=verafin,safe-sip CAPTURE_DIALOGS=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/capture.spec.ts --grep @capture --project=desktop
acceptance.evidence: Settled screenPos with the panel open (panel left 806 px): verafin x 410, safe-sip x 406, both the center of the area left of the panel. The round 1 safe-sip shot (case at x 640 to 806) was taken mid framing shift: capture.spec took the dialog shot as soon as the dialog was visible. Fixes: stop cards hidden while a story is open (verafin's case was under the card), and capture.spec now waits for the slide-in and a still screenPos. After captures: verafin case x 225 to 590, safe-sip case x 245 to 590, both whole and clear of the panel.

acceptance.criterion: grep -n 'color-scheme: dark' src/app/global.css; dark scrollbar at 1440x900 with scrollbars shown
acceptance.command: grep -n 'color-scheme: dark' src/app/global.css; scratch Chromium 141 run with --hide-scrollbars removed
acceptance.evidence: The declaration was already there before this WP (global.css html rule since 1c04668, plus the color-scheme meta in index.html); the round 1 evidence missed it. Added scrollbar-color: var(--border-secondary) var(--ink) next to it. Probe: the gallery html computes color-scheme dark, its 15 px gutter strip renders only ink (11, 11, 13); the classic /resume/ page in the same browser (light system theme) renders a light track (252) and a grey thumb, so the probe does show native scrollbars.

acceptance.criterion: Pixel 7 year chip at volunteer-door, safe-sip and desk
acceptance.command: CAPTURE_STOPS=volunteer-door,safe-sip,desk npx playwright test tests/e2e/capture.spec.ts --grep @capture --project=pixel7; npx vitest run src/overlay/model.test.ts
acceptance.evidence: Before: 2025, 2026, 2022. After: 2025, 2025, FRONT DESK. chipLabel holds the door's main-aisle year inside a wing and uses the rail's own 'Front desk' end label at the desk; unit tests cover every main stop, the desk and every wing.

acceptance.criterion: npm run verify and npm run build
acceptance.command: npm run verify && npm run build
acceptance.evidence: lint, prettier, typecheck clean; vitest 65 files, 737 tests passed; build ok, budgets ok, check-copy ok.

acceptance.criterion: All e2e and a11y specs stay green (visual baselines excluded: R0 regenerates them in CI)
acceptance.evidence: Full run, 1 worker, PORT=4175: 161 passed, 249 skipped (project filters), 82 failed, all with ECONNREFUSED on :4175 after the reused local serve-dist (a background probe server) hit its 30 min time limit mid-run; no assertion failures. playwright test --last-failed on those 82 against a fresh server: 82 passed. Total 243 passed, 0 failed, a11y included. npm run visual not run: baselines change by design and R0 regenerates them in CI.

deviations: tests/e2e/capture.spec.ts changed (not in the brief's e2e allowance, which covers the F-021 assertion and broken specs): the dialog shot now waits for the panel slide and a still screenPos. Without it the round 2 capture would show the same mid-shift frame that produced F-028's safe-sip evidence. It is in the F-028 commit and can be dropped by R0 or R8 if unwanted.
screenPos('desk') is new runtime behaviour behind the unchanged frozen type (screenPos(id: ExhibitId)); specs pass 'desk' with a cast. It returns the center of the four desk object hit boxes.
F-030 needed no fix: color-scheme: dark was already on html in global.css. Only scrollbar-color was added.
openQuestions: R0: accept the capture.spec.ts settle wait (see deviations), or hand it to R8.
R8: an e2e for F-020 (pixel7 desk: screenPos('desk' as never).y below the desk card's top) was not added, because the brief limits tests/e2e to the F-021 assertion. Suggest adding it to camera.spec.
Smaller portrait phones (360 x 640) still have a proportionally taller desk card; DESK_PORTRAIT_Y is tuned for 412 x 839. Re-check at round 2 if the reviewer scores other phones.

Visual baselines that change: stop-desk-pixel7 (framing, chip, card), every pixel7 stop's year chip inside the volunteer and projects wings, and dialog baselines if they include the HUD or rail. Deferred to R0 in CI.
notes: Integration: disjoint from F-G2a and F-G2c globs. F-G2c or F-G2a changes to the environment (labels3d, Floor) may move the end-wall line on the phone desk; re-check that the label stays clear of the HUD at DESK_PORTRAIT_Y 0.34 after the batch merge. Exhibit copy untouched.
